facts.text: American Flag was deployed at Ocean of Storms during Apollo 12 in 1969.
Planted by Conrad and Bean during EVA-1. Like all Apollo flags, it has a horizontal rod to keep it extended. Bleached white by decades of UV radiation.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Served as a visual reference point in photographs, helping scientists reconstruct the precise layout and distances of the EVA work area.
Status: Preserved at Ocean of Storms.
LROC images suggest the flag may have been knocked over by the ascent engine exhaust during departure from the surface.
